summary: DINI Communications is a small, Edison-based IT consultancy and systems integrator founded in 1998, holding New Jersey and New York State OGS contract vendor status for computer consulting, systems integration and training. It sells outsourced help desk/NOC monitoring, network and security engineering, staging/asset management and web development, mostly to public-sector New York City and New York State agencies plus a few large integrators. The same Edison office also runs a Pearson VUE testing center, and the company appears to take all inquiries by phone, email or a basic web form with no online booking, portal or published job postings.

facts.fact: DINI describes itself as a New Jersey State Corporation in business since 1998 and an approved New Jersey State and New York State OGS contractor for computer consulting, systems integration and training contracts.
Corporate headquarters is 340 Campus Drive, Edison, NJ 08837, phone (732) 225-4514, fax (732) 225-4518; the company also lists a branch office in Metuchen, NJ.

Named clients include the NYC Department of Education, NYC DoITT, FDNY, HRA, NYC Law Department, Office of Chief Medical Examiner, The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey, Northrop Grumman, CDW and Computer Aid Inc.

Service lines include contact center / toll-free help desk support, 24x7 NOC network monitoring, IDS management, system integration and network design, unified communications, wireless, project management, warehousing/staging and website design.
DINI operates a Pearson VUE testing center inside its Edison office, open Monday through Friday 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM, closed weekends and public holidays, with exams@dini.net as the contact.

The careers page lists no open positions; candidates are told to email a resume to resume@dini.net, and the company says it recruits "highly skilled consultants in all major technology practices" with a focus on networking and web technologies.
A news post states that in August 2025 DINI celebrated its 28-year business anniversary.
DINI announced a partnership with Aviva Services Inc., a New York State and New York City certified Minority/Women Owned Business, effective March 2016.
Engineers are described as holding Cisco (CCNA/CCNP/CCIE, security, wireless, IP telephony), Microsoft MCSE, Citrix CCA and PMP certifications.
The CSR page says DINI has sponsored roughly 400 meals twice a month for homeless people through St. John's Soup Kitchen in Newark since 2014 and sponsored 13,455 meals across the U.S. in 2019.
Staging and warehousing services include receiving, configuration, asset tagging with barcode labels and asset tracking reports delivered as spreadsheets.

operations_signals: Inquiry channels are a toll-free 'Live Support' line 877-825-3464, the corporate line (732) 225-4514, a fax number, info@dini.net, and a web contact form requiring Name, Address, Contact No., email and Message; no online booking, quote calculator or customer portal is offered (https://dini.net/contact-us/).

Company advertises a 24-hour toll-free help desk, 24x7 remote diagnostics and a 24-hour NOC that logs into client systems and escalates through client/vendor contacts (https://dini.net/contact-center-support/).
Service incidents are tracked and reported with 'real time access via the web' for clients, implying a ticketing system with a client-facing web view (https://dini.net/contact-center-support/).

Physical counter hours exist only for the test center (Mon-Fri 9:00-4:30, closed weekends/holidays), and candidates must email exams@dini.net or call the toll-free line to reach it (https://dini.net/pearson-vue-testing-center/).

Service area is anchored on one Edison office plus a Metuchen branch, but the client roster is largely New York City agencies, implying recurring travel/on-site coverage across the Hudson (https://dini.net/our-clients/).
No published general office hours for consulting/help desk intake; the only stated hours on the site are the test center's weekday 9:00-4:30 window (https://dini.net/pearson-vue-testing-center/).
hiring_signals: No job postings are published: the careers page is a single paragraph directing candidates to email resume@dini.net for 'current / upcoming employment opportunities' (https://dini.net/careers/).

Stated recruiting focus is 'highly skilled consultants in all major technology practices with a special focus on networking and web technologies', i.e. engineer/consultant roles rather than admin roles (https://dini.net/careers/).

Benefits advertised to candidates include competitive salaries, health and dental, 401k and career development, which is the only public signal about internal HR/admin workload (https://dini.net/careers/).
review_themes: No public customer reviews were located on any review platform; a BBB site search for 'Dini Communications' in Edison, NJ returned no results, so there is no BBB profile to read (https://www.bbb.org/search?find_country=USA&find_text=Dini%20Communications&find_loc=Edison%2C%20NJ).

Google, Yelp and Glassdoor pages were blocked to automated access during this research, so no review themes (response times, billing, scheduling) could be verified (https://www.yelp.com/biz/dini-communications-edison).
The company's own site instead frames service quality through certification claims and 24x7 coverage rather than testimonials or case studies (https://dini.net/about-us/).
tech_footprint: Website runs WordPress on a Twenty Twenty-One child theme with the Elementor page builder, Contact Form 7 plus reCAPTCHA, and an 'Epic News' plugin; stack versions in page source date to 2022 (https://dini.net/contact-us/).
Homepage links staff to an Outlook/Office 365 web login, indicating Microsoft 365 for email and collaboration (https://dini.net/).
No booking or scheduling widget, no live chat, no e-commerce, no jobs portal and no client login on the public site - intake is phone, email and a five-field form only (https://dini.net/contact-us/).

Content footprint is thin: the news feed contains only posts for the Aviva partnership and anniversary announcements, and the newest page edit in the sitemap is October 2025 (https://dini.net/wp-sitemap-posts-page-1.xml).

The company does publish a client-facing capability for web-based incident tracking and reporting, which implies they already operate a ticketing/reporting tool internally (https://dini.net/contact-center-support/).
An 'Authorized Personnel' page exists in the site structure but renders only a heading with no directory content (https://dini.net/authorized-personnel/).
growth_signals: 28-year anniversary celebrated in August 2025 indicates continuity rather than rapid expansion (https://dini.net/news-events/).
Partnership with Aviva Services Inc., a NY State/NYC M/WBE-certified firm, announced effective March 2016, positioned to extend public-sector reach (https://dini.net/news-events/).
Client roster is weighted toward New York City and New York State agencies plus the Port Authority, consistent with its OGS contract vendor approvals (https://dini.net/our-clients/).

A second revenue line, the Pearson VUE testing center, runs out of the Edison headquarters and lists 19 exam sponsors including Cisco, CompTIA, PMI, VMware and Oracle (https://dini.net/pearson-vue-testing-center/).
Community program scaled from monthly soup-kitchen meals since 2014 to 13,455 meals sponsored in 2019, the only quantified growth number published on the site (https://dini.net/csr/).
decision_maker: Unknown - the site's 'Authorized Personnel' page renders only a heading with no names, and no owner, president or GM is named on the home, about, contact, careers or news pages (https://dini.net/authorized-personnel/).

inferences.inference: DINI is likely a small, owner-led shop rather than a mid-size integrator.
inferences.reasoning: It publishes no staff directory or leadership names, only two news posts since 2022, one main office plus a branch, and a careers page that takes resumes by email instead of posting requisitions - all patterns typical of a company well under 50 staff.

inferences.inference: Quote-to-project intake is almost certainly manual and phone/email driven.
inferences.reasoning: The only intake paths are a toll-free line, a corporate line, a fax number, info@dini.net and a five-field Contact Form 7 form; there is no estimator, booking tool or portal, so a person has to read each inquiry, qualify it and route it to an engineer or PM.

inferences.inference: The 24x7 help desk and NOC promise creates shift-scheduling and escalation-coordination work that is likely handled with spreadsheets or a basic ticketing tool.
inferences.reasoning: The site promises 24-hour coverage, remote diagnostics and escalation through client, vendor and carrier contacts, but the only tooling it advertises is web-based incident reporting - no workforce-management or on-call scheduling product is visible.

inferences.inference: The Pearson VUE test center shares staff and front-desk capacity with the consulting office.
inferences.reasoning: The site states the testing center 'is a part of a functional office' at the same 340 Campus Drive address and warns candidates that day-to-day office work may intrude, which implies shared reception/admin and manual exam-slot scheduling by phone or email.

inferences.inference: Public-sector work with NYC agencies implies heavy manual compliance and billing paperwork.
inferences.reasoning: Clients include NYC DOE, DoITT, FDNY, HRA, NYC Law Department, OCME and the Port Authority, contracts that typically require timesheets, prevailing-wage or M/WBE documentation and invoice reconciliation that small integrators usually run in spreadsheets.

inferences.inference: Internal automation budget and appetite look low.
inferences.reasoning: The public site still runs a 2022-era Elementor/Contact Form 7 stack, has no chat or booking, no blog cadence and no careers ATS - suggesting IT investment goes into client infrastructure rather than its own front and back office.

inferences.inference: There is likely little inbound lead flow from digital channels.
inferences.reasoning: With no marketing content, no reviews on major platforms and no BBB profile, business probably arrives through state contract vehicles and referrals rather than web discovery, which shapes where an agent would add value (intake response and proposal admin rather than lead capture).

data_gaps: No employee headcount, revenue or ownership details found; opencorporates and bizapedia were blocked by JavaScript/CAPTCHA and NJ business-entity search was not reachable.
No named decision maker: the 'Authorized Personnel' page is empty and no leadership names appear on the site.
Job-board data unavailable: Indeed, LinkedIn, Glassdoor and ZipRecruiter all returned 403/bot challenges, so no current or historical postings could be reviewed.
No customer review themes available: Google, Yelp and Glassdoor blocked; BBB search for the company in Edison returned no results.

Web search tooling was rate-limited or unavailable for most of the session (Exa 429, OpenAI quota, Gemini unconfigured; DuckDuckGo, Mojeek, Brave and Google returned CAPTCHAs and Bing returned cached generic results), so external mentions in news, trade press or government contract award databases could not be verified.
Client list and OGS contract approvals are self-reported on dini.net and were not independently confirmed against state vendor records.
No published general business hours, after-hours escalation policy or service-area map beyond the Edison/Metuchen addresses.
